user.title: Makerspace Heating
user.description: Choose the boiler switch and the shared events calendar. Add rooms afterwards from the integration page.

data_description.boiler_switch: The Shelly relay that calls the boiler for heat.
data_description.calendar: Events tagged with a room's tag (for example #workshop) heat that room.

error.boiler_is_valve: This switch is already a room's valve.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Makerspace Heating is already set up.

data.keep_open_minutes: Keep valves open after the boiler stops

data_description.control_mode: Shadow decides everything but switches nothing. Use it to compare with the old setup before switching to Active.
data_description.default_boost_minutes: Used by the physical buttons and the dashboard Boost button.
data_description.max_boost_minutes: The longest boost anyone can start from a dashboard or action.
data_description.valve_wait_minutes: How long a valve must report open before the boiler fires. 0 turns the wait off.
data_description.notify_actions: Actions such as notify.mobile_app_phone. Each fault is sent once when raised and once when cleared.

error.default_above_max: The default boost cannot be longer than the maximum boost.
error.step_above_max: The dropdown step cannot be longer than the maximum boost.
error.invalid_notify_action: Use the form notify.service_name, for example notify.mobile_app_phone.

data_description.tag: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Calendar events containing #tag heat this room.
data_description.button: Optional. A Shelly input as an event entity (button mode) or a binary sensor (switch mode).
data_description.preheat_minutes: How long before an event starts to begin heating.

error.invalid_tag: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
error.tag_in_use: Another room already uses this tag.
error.valve_in_use: Another room already uses this valve.
error.frost_above_targets: The frost target must not be above the boost and event targets.

options.shadow: Shadow: decide but do not switch anything

fault.title: {message}
fault.description: Makerspace Heating detected this fault. It clears automatically once fixed.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Start or restart a boost in one or more rooms.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to boost for. Defaults to the default boost length and must not exceed the maximum.
